itemListElement.name: Granola AI Pricing in 2026: What US Users Actually Pay

mainEntity.name: How much is Granola per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Granola Business costs $14 per user per month and Enterprise costs $35 per user per month. The Basic plan is free.
Yes. Granola Basic is free with no time limit, but it keeps only 30 days of meeting history. To keep older notes, you need Business at $14 per user per month.
Only on Enterprise. Granola's help center says Basic and Business are billed monthly and annual billing is available on Enterprise contracts only.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Granola Business and Enterprise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Business ($14) adds unlimited history, advanced AI models and integrations. Enterprise ($35) adds SSO, admin controls, org-wide auto-deletion, usage analytics and priority support.

mainEntity.name: Does Granola charge per meeting or per minute?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Granola charges per user per month. None of its plans list a minute or meeting cap; the free plan's limit is 30 days of history.

mainEntity.name: Is there a cheaper alternative to Granola?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies Pro costs $10 per seat billed yearly and Fathom's free plan records unlimited calls.
